budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Keep four kitchens serving their own changing festival orders by transporting food through distinct equipment stages, protecting heat, fueling the shared boiler and returning reusable trays through hands or a finite routed conveyor.
task.natural_termination: No natural success or joint-failure terminal. This is a continuing finite world. H=384 truncates the observation window, not a success event; done inputs are absorbing.
task.interaction: A dish requires different equipment in four locations. Route switches and occupancy change another kitchen's item delay and freshness. Plating removes a shared clean tray until a served or expired dish's dirty tray is washed and returned. Physical reports reveal another kitchen's order for a limited time; insulated porter tools alter hot-food transport timing and can be exchanged.
task.observation_access: The map, all physical staff cargo, stations, belt occupancy/direction, fuel/water levels, service clocks, public events and reward components are public. Current order flavour is directly visible only to the four actors belonging to that kitchen: order_visible is the kitchen-equality mask. Each observation adds only that actor's own notes and note_life rows. Speaking transfers the speaker's current home order to adjacent actors; foreign notes expire and can disagree with a changed live order. Legal serving masks do not test hidden flavour equality. A full-state/debug view must be labelled separately.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Food waste count in this native step
Occupied belt source cells that moved

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
